description: Verified external project links shown in the public Projects section. The same file drives the UI cards and the idempotent MongoDB seeder, so the portfolio and the database can never drift apart. Add an object here to publish another link.
source: Descriptions were read from the live pages on 2026-11-03. No invented statistics, technology stack, metrics or achievements are included.

projects.title: CellarKeep — Client Portal
projects.label: Featured · Client portal
projects.description: Secure client portal for a liquor store management system: dedicated client accounts, a loyalty club, order tracking, and verified M-PESA and card receipts.
features: Loyalty points, tasting programmes and concierge chat

projects.title: HomeScape — Property Marketplace
projects.label: Featured · Property marketplace
projects.description: A property marketplace for finding a home: search listings by type, city and price, contact owners, save properties and request viewings.
features: Search by property type, city, price and buy or rent
Seller accounts for managing listings and inquiries
Saved properties, owner inquiries and viewing appointments
Indicative price estimates based on active asking prices
securityNotes: Showcase homes are labelled illustrative examples and are not available to buy or rent
Indicative price estimates are based on active asking prices
Buyers can contact owners and request viewing appointments

projects.title: Pro-Studio-Master — Music Studio
projects.label: Featured · Open-source DAW
projects.description: A full music studio that runs on your own computer: a multi-track DAW with a piano roll, a 3D mixer, built-in instruments, live effects and beat tools. Open source, and your projects stay on your machine.
features: Multi-track DAW timeline with clips, tempo, swing and a piano roll with quantise and sustain
3D mixer with rotary group racks for level, pan and width, plus master processing
Built-in synths, a performance keyboard with scales, scale lock and an arpeggiator
Multi-track recording with stereo and mic routing per track
CLAP plugin scanning in a sandbox, with audio time-warp and pitch shifting
securityNotes: Projects are saved on your computer, in apps/studio-server/data inside the project folder
The studio listens on 127.0.0.1 only — native builds on :8787, Docker on :8000
Installs to ~/pro-studio-master, with the folder overrideable via PSM_DIR
Only deliberate internet features: online beat search, update checks, and downloading the build
The setup script checks for the required tools and reports anything missing before building
